props.title: Signet Artists — Live music for private events in Denver, Colorado
props.description: Live music for private events across Colorado, from a solo musician to a full band, on one contract with a personal contact for the night. Send us the date.

props.title: Check out signet's growing book of Flavorful Acts
props.lede: From singer-songwriters, cover artists, jazz, flamenco, string quartets, funk and DJ options to sound baths, Signet Artists offers many of our acts as solo, duo, trio and more players. Some with a notable front-person and others are purpose-built for your event. We've highlighted a few below,

props._notes:
Pillar 2 as a picture. Rewritten 2026-08-15: this block described two house
     bands and a DJ, which is not what the business is. It is an agency booking
     named acts, so the home page shows the three flagship acts and sends the
     rest to the roster. The evening still warms here, paper-sunk, before the
     night section inverts.

"americana" left this list 2026-08-27 with the Thomas Owen Band
           (acts.json holds). The genre list is hand-typed: it must shrink and
           grow with the roster. No count in the heading, 2026-09-07: a genre
           list survives a new act, an integer does not. Sound bath and sound
           healing joined the list 2026-09-19 on Daniel's instruction ("it should
           say sound bath, or sound healing, or other related search terms");
           the sentence is his, only the list moved. String quartets joined 2026-09-25
           on Daniel's call ("what is the shape of the search demand? do that"):
           "string quartet denver", "string quartet wedding denver", "string quartet
           colorado springs" and "string quartet for corporate events" all
           autocomplete, and the violinist family is smaller, so the quartet is the
           word. Only the list moved.

The sleeves, wired in 2026-08-07. It sits directly under the roster because
     range is a claim about what we can play and this is the only evidence for
     it on the page. Full-bleed on the night ground, so the strip also does the
     arc's work: the roster section warms and the sleeves drop to midnight. The
     late-night band that used to follow was cut on 2026-08-17 with the Q4
     refocus, so the strip is the only night ground on the page now and pricing
     returns to paper directly after it.

props.title: nobody wants to get the booking wrong
props.lede: Hiring the right entertainment can be nerve-racking. Everyone's got an opinion, and to some degree, your reputation might be on the line.

headingText.html: Signet Artists makes it hard to get wrong. You get an act that fits your vision, sound support that's the right size for the venue, and clear, professional support all along the way.

props.html: Learn what live music costs in different markets including Colorado, the Front Range and Nationally.

props._notes:
Pricing, on the home page. Rewritten 2026-09-04 with the no-published-price
     decision. The section's job used to be "we publish a card". It is now that
     the market's numbers are on the site, sourced, so a budget can be set, and
     that Signet prices the date. One button, and a text link to the page that
     carries the figures. The hero above is untouched.
